If I could give 10 stars,I would.They have treated my hens as well as my dogs and above all I could gush about,the outstanding thing is their kindness.As well as my own pets,I've landed them with various wild animals,injured on roads over the years,even a young deer once,they have ALWAYS, without question done all in their power.After my hen had to go asleep,they posted me a card with her footprint,a treasure I'll keep forever.Last week,my Whinger was seen by Muireann,he had hurt his back,she wouldn't lift him on the table in case she hurt him and that girl sat on the floor with him instead,have you ever seen a vet do that?That's how much they love each and every animal goes through their doors.She is seeing him on Friday but phoned on Wednesday to ask how he's doing,the kindness of these people,both vets and receptionists is overwhelming.Here,animals come before all else,under no circumstances would I take my precious ones anywhere else.Simply put,these people love animals.Cannot recommend highly enough.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I recently brought my very nervous dog, Brax, to Millstreet Veterinary Group Practice after he broke his dewclaw, and I couldn't be more impressed. Brax is usually very anxious, but the team was absolutely outstanding in how they handled him. They were incredibly gentle and made sure he felt comfortable throughout the visit. It's the calmest I’ve ever seen him in a veterinary setting, which really speaks volumes. We travel all the way from Mallow to Millstreet because of how fantastic they are, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality care for their pets. Thank you for taking such great care of Brax!
